verdict.rationale: The evidence only indirectly points to programmatic error-data access. An official MCP server connects to BugSnag using "manual API tokens" (now also OAuth 2.0), and a webhook forwards error and project data as it is processed. No documented REST endpoints for listing, querying or updating issues or fetching raw events appear, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. Missing for 10: documented REST API reference for listing/filtering/updating errors, raw event retrieval endpoints, token scoping/permission model, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
